response.text: I'll start by checking several potential problem areas in parallel.

arguments.sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr FROM public."GLJRNH" h JOIN public."GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY h."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(COALESCE(l."DR_AMT",0)) <> SUM(COALESCE(l."CR_AMT",0))

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."INV_DT", COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY regexp_replace(upper(trim(i."VEND_CD")),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g'), regexp_replace(ltrim(upper(trim(i."INV_NO")),'0'),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g')) AS dupcnt FROM public."APINVH" i WHERE (regexp_replace(upper(trim(i."VEND_CD")),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g'), regexp_replace(ltrim(upper(trim(i."INV_NO")),'0'),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g')) IN (SELECT regexp_replace(upper(trim("VEND_CD")),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g'), regexp_replace(ltrim(upper(trim("INV_NO")),'0'),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g') FROM public."APINVH" GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" FROM public."GLJRNH" h JOIN public."GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT"
SELECT l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD" FROM public."GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN public."GLCOA" c ON c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD" WHERE c."ACCT_CD" IS NULL OR c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", SUM(COALESCE(p."PAY_AMT",0)) AS paid FROM public."APINVH" i LEFT JOIN public."APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(COALESCE(p."PAY_AMT",0)) <> i."INV_AMT" AND i."INV_ID" IN (SELECT "INV_ID" FROM public."APINVH" WHERE "STAT_CD"='P')

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr, SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr FROM public."APINVH" i JOIN public."GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" JOIN public."GLCOA" c ON c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD" WHERE trim(c."ACCT_CD")='2000' GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(COALESCE(l."CR_AMT",0)) <> i."INV_AMT"

SELECT p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", p."PAY_DT", i."INV_DT" FROM public."APPAYM" p LEFT JOIN public."APINVH" i ON i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" WHERE i."INV_ID" IS NULL OR p."PAY_DT" < i."INV_DT" OR p."PAY_AMT" <= 0
